actions.name: invoke_custom_py_code
actions.title: Execute code
actions.help: Execute custom Python code in the recipe. Write your code within the main function. Standard libraries available in the Python distribution are included. This action will timeout after 90 seconds.

input.name: name
input.label: Name
input.hint: What does this step do? E.g.: Get account details/Transform customer data etc.

input.name: code_input
input.label: Input fields
input.hint: Define the input fields that will be passed to your Python code

input.name: code_output_schema_json
input.label: Output fields
input.hint: Learn how to configure output for this action here .

input.name: payload_asset_type
input.label: Python snippet source
input.hint: • Define manually — Write the Python snippet directly in this action. • Use a resource — Reference a snippet file managed in your Workato project.

input.name: snippet_document_static_asset
input.label: Python Snippet Resource
input.hint: Select a Python snippet resource to be used for executing the code.
